onboarding.welcomeText: Block Blast is a puzzle game where your goal is to score as many points as possible by placing blocks on the grid.
onboarding.dragText: Drag shapes from the tray at the bottom and drop them onto the 8x8 grid. You can place them anywhere they fit!
onboarding.clearText: Fill an entire row or column to clear it. Clearing multiple lines at once gives you a huge score bonus!
onboarding.strategyText: The game ends when you can't fit any more blocks. Plan ahead and keep the grid clear to survive!
